description:
Somos un equipo de estudiantes del Centro de Bachillerato Tecnológico Industrial y de Servicios No. 30 , interesados en la tecnología y el desarrollo de nuevas ideas. 

Nuestro objetivo es explorar la historia de expediciones en Marte, conocer las tecnologías utilizadas, los descubrimientos obtenidos y los desafíos que tuvieron que superar los científicos e ingenieros para llevarlas a cabo.
summary: We created a story using information about the Ingenuity mission. We obtained the information from NASA's official website. We developed it for a younger audience, designing it to make the information about this mission easier to understand and to spark curiosity about the topic.
details: Our project consists of creating an educational story based on NASA's Ingenuity mission. Through an illustrated story, we explain the mission, the helicopter's features, its flights, and its importance in the exploration of Mars. The story uses illustrations, dialogues, and situations to present scientific information in a simple and entertaining way. Its main benefits are making learning easier, encouraging reading, and sparking interest in science, technology, and space exploration. Our expected impact is to bring science closer to a younger audience and show that scientific topics can also be learned in a fun and creative way. To develop the project, we used Canva to design and organize the story, digital tools to create the illustrations, and NASA's official website as a reliable source of information. The creativity of our project comes from transforming real scientific information into an illustrated story, using characters and dialogues to make it more attractive and easier to understand. During its development, our team considered the age of the target audience, the use of simple language, the accuracy of the information, the quality of the illustrations, and the organization of the content. Our goal was to keep readers interested and spark their curiosity about space exploration.
